name: dev.ucp.lodging.guest_loyalty
title: Lodging Guest Loyalty Extension
description: Lets a Platform pass a guest's hotel loyalty membership number to the Business so post-stay rewards can be credited. The number is request-only: the Business never echoes it back. This extension never affects booking status or pricing.

program.description: Loyalty program key in reverse-domain notation. Must be one of the keys the Business advertises in guest_loyalty.accepted_programs.

loyalty_membership_request.description: A loyalty membership number supplied by the buyer for one guest. Request-only.

member_id.description: Membership number exactly as the buyer provided it, trimmed of leading/trailing whitespace. Treated as a sensitive identifier: MUST NOT be echoed by the Business, logged in clear text, or included in analytics.

accepted_program.description: A loyalty program the Business can credit for this property or rate.

name.description: Human-readable program name, suitable for display to the buyer.

membership_status.description: Business-side outcome for one submitted membership. Never contains the member number or a masked form of it.

guest_id.description: Platform-generated Guest.id the membership was submitted for.

recorded.description: True if the Business stored the number against the stay for post-stay crediting. False if it was discarded (see messages[]).

provisional.description: True unless the Business has verified the membership (for example via Identity Linking). Mirrors dev.ucp.common.loyalty. display_id is intentionally not defined here.

guest_loyalty.description: Response-only state for the guest loyalty extension.

accepted_programs.description: Programs the Business can credit. Presence of this list, together with a loyalty_member_id_requested message, authorises the Platform to collect a number.

memberships.description: Outcome for each membership submitted in the most recent Update.

dev.ucp.lodging.booking.title: Lodging Booking with Guest Loyalty
dev.ucp.lodging.booking.description: Lodging Booking extended with guest loyalty membership capture.

loyalty_memberships.description: Loyalty numbers for this guest. Send only on the guest assigned role=primary, only after the Business requested one, and only with buyer consent.
